name: Project Analysis
description: Auto-detect host project: stack, routes, auth, DB, package managers.

name: User Story Analysis
description: Parse a user story or epic — extract AC, scenarios, risks, edge cases, security scenarios.

name: Test Case Generation
description: Produce Arabic XLSX + MD test cases saved in output/{story-id}/test-cases/

name: Playwright E2E Generation
description: Scaffold JavaScript Playwright POM + spec files in output/{story-id}/e2e/

name: Test Data Generation
description: Generate JSON test data files in output/{story-id}/test-data/ for each E2E suite

name: Test Execution
description: Run Playwright tests in configured mode (headed/headless) with configured browser

name: Bug Analysis
description: Triage test failures, generate Arabic bug reports in output/{story-id}/bug-reports/

name: QA Reporting
description: Aggregate QA summary (HTML + MD + XLSX) in output/{story-id}/reports/
outputs: HTML dashboard, XLSX report, MD summary

name: Full QA Workflow
description: MASTER — run all 7 phases: analyze → generate → run → report

name: Regression Testing
description: Re-run baseline test suite and diff against previous results

name: Security Validation
description: OWASP-style validation pass on detected endpoints

name: Autonomous Testing
description: Bounded plan→act→observe→reflect loop for autonomous QA
